meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: 它会读取 .omo/plans 下的工作计划,自己不写代码,把每项实现、测试、审查拆成子任务交给并行子代理执行,并维护 Boulder 状态与证据账本,直到计划中所有顶层复选框完成。
howto.when: 当你输入 $ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 中的计划时触发;若找不到可选计划,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.text: 运行 .omo/plans 里的 login-refactor 计划
say.note: 选中该计划并开始并行执行
每个阶段交付一个 pull request
跟进到 PR 合并并清理工作树

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it reads a plan under .omo/plans, delegates every implementation, test and review unit to parallel subagents, edits no product files itself, and tracks Boulder state until all checkboxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type $ulw-execute or ask to run a plan in .omo/plans; if no plan is selectable, it first calls ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Selects that plan and starts parallel execution
Delivers each phase as a pull request
Follows through to PR merge and cleanup
